purpose: Select a shared, reward-blind warm start with enough independent route and digit support to power the unchanged Stage C3 credit-confusion gate, after validating a crash-proof scorer lifecycle.

v1_terminal_record.failure_class: Native Python/vLLM finalization aborted after the signed candidate-1 root scores were durably written and explicit engine shutdown completed.
v1_terminal_record.accepted_disposition: v1 is terminal and is never resumed or retried.
v1_terminal_record.disposition: v1 remains closed; v2 is a distinct selection with fresh SFT randomness
v1_terminal_record.freshness_reason: V1 exposed the complete SFT checkpoint hashes and candidate-1 support result. V2 retires seed 7203001 and uses a new SFT trajectory so no observed v1 candidate is replayed, skipped, or selected.

factorized_dataset.construction: Eight balanced root-only examples plus the complete 4-route by 8-digit Cartesian product in separate target-only examples.
factorized_dataset.policy: The v1 corpus is reused byte-for-byte because it contains no outcome information and v1 revealed no corpus defect.

initialization.selection_training_model: The inherited adapter is first merged into the named base model in BF16, then one new LoRA is trained against that exact deployed initialization.

sft.one_run_rule: After the first optimizer step, do not rerun SFT, change the corpus, change hyperparameters, or train replacement candidates.

candidate_selection.rule: Select the earliest ascending optimizer checkpoint satisfying every frozen check; later checkpoints are not consulted.
candidate_selection.no_passing_candidate: Record a terminal Stage C4 selection failure, run no RL campaign, recover compact artifacts, and do not retry this selection.

authoritative_scoring.model_form: BF16 merged model, never runtime-LoRA scores
authoritative_scoring.engine: The same pinned vLLM installation and model-loading mode used by the campaign.
authoritative_scoring.action_measurement: Exact full-vocabulary next-token probabilities retempered analytically.
authoritative_scoring.root_measurement: Exact complete route-sequence probabilities, including EOS.
authoritative_scoring.factorization_measurement: Measure route-conditioned normalized digit distributions on all four exact campaign prefixes and require both TV and mutual-information bounds.

unchanged_v3_power_gate.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true and separators=(',', ':')
unchanged_v3_power_gate.policy: Every v3 exact-power check remains mandatory and byte-identical; selection adds stricter margins but changes no campaign threshold.

separation.campaign_freeze_condition: A selected adapter hash, merged-model manifest, complete support report, and selection terminal record are local before any v4 RL model call.

scorer_lifecycle_gate.position: after inherited-model merge and before the first v2 SFT optimizer step
scorer_lifecycle_gate.model: The exact inherited BF16 merged model used to initialize v2 SFT.
scorer_lifecycle_gate.cases: The frozen action and root case sets used by candidate selection.
scorer_lifecycle_gate.worker_contract: Atomically write and fsync the signed payload, explicitly shut down vLLM, flush streams, and exit via os._exit so native extension finalizers are not run.
scorer_lifecycle_gate.pass_condition: Both parent-verified sentinels exist and the lifecycle manifest is complete.
scorer_lifecycle_gate.failure_handling: Any nonzero exit, missing output, parse error, signature mismatch, or source mismatch terminally closes v2 before SFT.

pre_model_call_checks: Verify every frozen source and data hash.
Run all root tests and the affected Prime environment/dispatcher tests.
Parse the SFT configuration through Prime-RL SFTConfig.
Verify the expected external Prime patch reverse-applies.
Run the frozen v2 preregistration audit.
execution.failure_handling: After either lifecycle model-scoring call or any optimizer step, any failure is terminal for v2. Recover all existing compact artifacts and do not retry.
execution.local_artifact_policy: Keep exact scores, verification sentinels, manifests, signatures, logs, reports, and only the selected adapter. Do not sync intermediate adapters, merged 4B models, optimizer states, or redundant full-model shards.
execution.remote_cleanup: Remove each rejected merged candidate before scoring the next. Delete all remaining merged models and intermediate adapters at pod teardown.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

hardware.availability_observed: 2026-07-29 before freeze: non-spot resource 8b33a6 was Available at $1.08/hour; eligible 2x RTX 6000 Ada and L40S resources were also available at $1.50 and $1.64/hour, respectively.
hardware.selection_reason: The 2x A6000 is eligible, genuinely available, and the cheapest qualifying non-spot 2x48GB resource.
hardware.fallback_rule: Do not silently substitute hardware. If resource 8b33a6 is unavailable before the first model call, commit a hardware-only amendment and repeat the hash audit.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without model calls if it fails.

validation.known_unrelated_full_mypy_findings: 13 pre-existing missing generic annotations in six older Stage C test files.
